4364-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4364-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Move to your next turn. Optionally, you can instead give Massimo haste.
Declare Massimo and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 4 each combat phase.
4364-7431-8330.notes: You can also do this combo in one turn if you give the ability to a creature that has haste (excluding Aurelia) instead. If you give the ability to another creature, you will need to cause that creature to enter, target the creature with Massimo, and then replace Massimo in the combat phase with the creature. If you do this in one turn, either with Massimo or another creature, ensure that Aurelia has not attacked during that turn.

391-4222-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
391-4222-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
391-4222-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat from step 1

4222-4289-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
4222-4289-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-6794.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5070-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5070-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

907-5411-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Repeat.

5173-5553-5626-7729.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

206-3259-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
206-3259-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

206-560-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

465-4605-5147-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5205-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

141-3047-5686.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-3990-5517.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any type a land you control can produce
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat

2921-5220-6538-6900.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

618-5887-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

104-3641-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3641-4186.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-2043-4715-4772.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-3693-5544-5686-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-3693-5544-5686-6431.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

215-2757-6251.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
215-2757-6251.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard.
You control a basic Swamp and a basic Forest.
215-2757-6251.description:
Cast Aatchik either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Aatchik enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping two Insects, untapping a basic Swamp and a basic Forest.
Activate the Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Repeat from step 3 three additional times.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Aatchik from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-2757-6251.notes: If you have nine or more artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard, this combo will net infinite untapped tokens and untap of basic lands you control.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2770-5434-5555-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
2770-5434-5555-5686.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2043-4659-4840.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
The Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Urza to make infinite copies of any artifacts you control.

1961-2793-3334-5089.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting two loyalty counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2757-3590-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Warchanter Skald.
You control a basic Island.
2757-3590-4222.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Warchanter Skald, targeting a basic Island you control.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the Island.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

uses.n: Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged

2232-2757-3103-3474.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Forest and a basic Plains.
2232-2757-3103-3474.description:
Activate a basic Plains and a basic Forest you control by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Cast Kytheon by paying {W}.
Kytheon enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft twice by tapping the Cat Warrior token and Kytheon, untapping a basic Forest and a basic Plains.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Kytheon from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

813-1987-3075-4792.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
813-1987-3075-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
